verdict.rationale: Docusign offers building blocks that could support agentic compliance workflows — AI-Assisted Review with 'ready-to-deploy agents' that flag non-compliant clauses and draft language (docusign-docs-25, docusign-docs-16), CLM playbook-driven agreement generation, and an official MCP server letting an AI agent retrieve agreement context and trigger workflow actions (docusign-docs-11, docusign-docs-12, docusign-probe-3). However, there is no evidence of an agent autonomously preparing a full annual report or compliance filing end-to-end with minimal human input — these features are scoped to reviewing/redlining/signing agreements, not generating regulatory filings. Missing for 10: evidence of end-to-end autonomous filing/report generation, human-in-the-loop minimization for compliance filings specifically, and any case study or documentation describing this exact workflow.
